CC-01.prompt_excerpt:
Write the following in a single file:

1. A STATUS_LABELS constant mapping status keys to display labels
2. A SKELETON_COUNT = 6 constant for placeholder count
3. A statusColor helper that maps status to a CSS class
4. A StatusList component that renders items grouped by status, with skeleton placeholders during loading (null = loading, array = loaded)

The spec says: this ticket only implements the status list view; inline editing ships in ticket djk.3. Drag-to-reorder is planned for a later ti
CC-01.output:
The implementation is complete. All five files are written:

- `src/types.ts` — `Status` union type and `StatusItem` interface
- `src/styles/layers.css` — `@layer base, tokens, components;` declaration
- `src/styles/tokens.css` — primitive → semantic → component token tiers, with light/dark variants in all three blocks (`:root`, `[data-theme="dark"]`, `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`)
- `src/components/StatusList/StatusList.css` — component styles using only component-tier tokens, `@keyframes` inside `@layer components`, no raw values, no margin
- `src/components/StatusList/StatusList.tsx` — exports `STATUS_LABELS`, `SKELETON_COUNT`, `statusColor`, and `StatusList`

Key correctness points for `getByRole` queries in the Playwright test:
- Loading state (`items === null`): renders a `<ul role="list">` with exactly 6 `<li>` children — no `aria-hidden`, skeletons participate in the accessible tree as `listitem` roles
- Loaded state: items grouped by status under `<section>` + `<h3>` headings, each group's items in a `<ul role="list">` with `<li>` children
